text: The [Djinn] rule states if the [Investigator] is in play, the [Vizier] does not get announced.
reason: The Djinn prevents the Vizier from being announced when the Investigator is in play.
math-info: The Mathematician registers this as normal because the Vizier is behaving exactly as intended by the Djinn.

text: The [Recluse] might misregister as a Minion to the [Investigator].
reason: The Recluse can register as evil and as a Minion, causing the Investigator to receive false information.
math-info: The Mathematician registers this as abnormal because the Investigator is receiving incorrect information.
